description.narrative: Overall indicator: Extent to which Border Police BiH technical capacity, knowledge and training for detection of illicit arms trafficking was increased. 1. Number of specialized detection equipment in possession by BPBiH to effectively detect the illicit arms trafficking in BiH. 2. Availability of operational assessment for Border Police BiH with recommendations for improvements in terms of available procedures, capabilities, training, equipment. 3. Extent to which regional exchange of good practices and experiences in combatting illicit firearms trafficking has improved 4. Number of SOPs on detection methods, risk analysis, tracing of arms, data collection, investigation, reaction in emergency situations non-existent. 5. Number of BPBiH staff trained to utilize the newly developed SOPs and specialized detection equipment. 6. Number of SOPs on processing of SALW related crimes for 16 police agencies in BiH. 7. Number of police officers from 16 police agencies in BiH trained to utilize the newly developed SOPs. 8. Availability of BPBiH green border analysis including definition of needs in terms of equipment and training. 9. Availability of Ministry of Security (MoS) database on transport of SALW in 2020.

comment.narrative: Overall indicator: BiH Border Police lacks the appropriate training, knowledge, operational assets and equipment to detect the illicit arms at BiH Border Points. 1. Zero specialized detection equipment in possession by BPBiH to effectively detect the illicit arms trafficking in BiH. 2. Lack of operational assessment for Border Police BiH with recommendations for improvements in terms of available procedures, capabilities, training, equipment. 3. Regional exchange of good practices and experiences in combatting illicit firearms trafficking in need of improvement. 4. SOPs on detection methods, risk analysis, tracing of arms, data collection, investigation, reaction in emergency situations non-existent. 5. Zero BPBiH staff trained to utilize the newly developed SOPs and specialized detection equipment. 6. SOPs on processing of SALW related crimes for 16 police agencies in BiH non-existent. 7. Zero police officers trained to utilize the newly developed SOPs. 8. BPBiH green border analysis including definition of needs in terms of equipment and training non-existent. 9. Ministry of Security (MoS) database on transport of SALW non-existent in 2018.
